recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is for core. Any future corrections to elementSource should be made in the FHIR Extension Pack repository and release process.
issue_request: Applied/Persuasive with Modification FHIR-I request to support Identifier lineage/source with a lightweight extension, broadened by the approved disposition to a reusable elementSource extension with Element context, uri value, and definition/comment aligned with Resource.meta.source and Provenance.
initial_application: No authoritative application was found in core source. The application appears in the FHIR Extension Pack: commit 871138995394afac84fe2bfcddbf13a9d955f83e added StructureDefinition-elementSource.xml for FHIR-47701 on 2025-07-16, and b87cef457db6f4a9e44d4c7ddf460d7843c620b4 changed its status to active.
additional_context: FHIR-I 2025-02-24 minutes confirm the approved elementSource disposition, Security WG input, and creation of related FHIR-49878 to clarify meta.source. FHIR-49878 is already represented on the combined branch. The Extension Pack IG includes input/definitions/* as source content and publication-request.json identifies hl7.fhir.uv.extensions version 5.3.0; tag 5.3.0 contains the elementSource implementation.
reconciliation: Published an empty external-repo audit commit on the core combined branch. No core source was changed because adding a parallel core elementSource definition would duplicate the Extension Pack source of truth.

related_jiras.note: Created during the same FHIR-I discussion to clarify meta.source granularity; already represented on the combined branch and not duplicated here.
